title: Rock-solid business continuity and data protection on Google Cloud
description: This session will explain how you can architect your mission-critical workloads on Google Cloud infrastructure to ensure high availability and resilience inline with your recovery point objective and recovery time objective requirements. We will cover architectures, product capabilities, and operational procedures to ensure that your organization can continue to function through interruptions to keep your mission-critical workloads running. Examples include easily deploying a critical database workload with resilience across multiple points of presence, bringing up a workload quickly and reliably when a disaster occurs, and managing backups at scale with cost efficiency.
